stable.notes: Set a Home city in Settings so Meeting Ask fact checks start from the right place. A meeting the server already finished no longer shows as Live now with hours of No audio. Pairs with server 6.71.13, which checks the whole meeting first and then only new content. Matched complete companion 637 adds the phone layout fixes, lens Fact check and the phone Home city setting. Experimental transcription and automatic cues remain off; physical phone and Android acceptance remains pending. Signed and notarized by Apple.

whatsNew.summary: Home city for fact checks, and no more stale Live now rows. Pairs with server 6.71.13 and complete companion 6.10.637.

sections.title: Home city
items: Settings, Meeting assistant card: set your Home city, like Austin, TX. Fact checks use it only when a claim leaves its starting point implicit, like flying from here, and say so.
City and state only, no street address. Leave it blank to use your phone's area. Needs server 6.71.13; older servers hide the field.

sections.title: Live now
items: A meeting the server already finished no longer shows as Live now with hours of No audio.
A session quiet longer than the server's 4 hour retention never reads Live now or Recording ended without saving.

sections.title: Server 6.71.13 and companion 637
items: The first Fact check covers the whole meeting; later ones cover only what is new, and the answer says which.
Companion 637 lines Views up with the tab bar on every phone, removes the empty status strip, adds Fact check on the lens and a phone Home city field.
Experimental transcription and automatic cue flags stay disabled. Stable transcription is unchanged.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
